ad2.note: his V2 beat sheet, boundaries read at the frame off his render; pushes from the per-0.25 s framing fit of his own render (cover.json)

notes.push_off_frac / pushed_holds_per_min: Ad 2 reads 0.016 / 0.22 while his own count is 15 pushes (39 % of talk): his Ad 2 ramps are shorter than the change-event HOLDS the tracker segments on, so a hold's median head height sits near the base level and the ramp is diluted. Ad 1's longer holds read 0.27 / 2.3. Both rows are therefore informational (lo = 0); the BINDING push row is `push_spread` (the gate's framing:push_coverage, x1.26 / x1.18) together with the hand count `pushes_hand_per_min` (3.6 / 3.3).
notes.naked_splices_per_min: his pose-matched same-scene cuts read 9.5 / 7.6 per minute with no plan; a kit build declares its punches so it reads lower. This is a RANGE for a from-raw cut, not a defect; the gate's bound is 12/min (formats.py).
notes.talking_head_luma: 66 / 72 on the scan's 160x90 frame mean over on-scene frames. VQC-C item 5 read him at ~67 against our 55 on an earlier instrument; the numbers agree.
notes.opening_changes_15s: both edits: exactly 4 changes in the first 15 s (the hook's picture beat + card + the 'today' photos + the episode plate). A 3.6..4.4 band means 4.
